title: Upgrade: v1.9.9-retention
summary:
Aligns evidence retention with deploy retention blocks.

Changes:
- Sets evidence.max_age_num_blocks to 88 (matching RETENTION_BLOCKS)
- Sets evidence.max_age_duration to 264s (88 blocks * 3s)
- Enables automatic block pruning to reduce disk usage

This upgrade allows the node to automatically prune old blocks and state, keeping disk usage bounded.

BINARY REQUIREMENT: All validators must update to v1.9.9 binary BEFORE the upgrade height.
